purpose: Focused promotion completeness review after the original real matrix; no broad rerun or production edit.
status: DO_NOT_PROMOTE_AS_COMPLETE_PRESERVATION_FIX: valid whitespace-only included hooksPath still overwritten by existing owner implementation.

new_finding.configuration: An included Git config sets core.hooksPath to a single space, naming a valid relative directory called one space in the checkout. git config --get returns space + newline, with exit 0.
new_finding.root_cause: The owner skip guard tests String(stdout || "").trim(), collapsing this valid configured path to an empty string. Lefthook also misses the included value in its scoped checks, then resolves the real relative hooks directory and replaces its pre-commit.
new_finding.observed: Main AND owner return 0, replace custom pre-commit and create pre-commit.old; all config bytes remain identical.
new_finding.suggested_owner_followup: Use successful effective-config lookup (status 0 / key presence), rather than trimmed value truthiness, as the skip condition. Preserve actual no-key status 1 as the ordinary-install path; choose explicit safe behavior for query errors. This is a design recommendation only, not an implemented patch.
new_finding.severity_context: Narrow edge configuration, but it defeats any claim that all user-configured hooks are preserved. Main already exhibits the behavior; this is an incompleteness of the proposed owner fix, not a regression introduced by it.

other_new_cases: CI=1 does not protect included hooks on current main: overwrite reproduced. Existing owner guard preserves the same setup.
extensions.worktreeConfig=true plus linked-worktree-only core.hooksPath: main overwrites; existing owner guard preserves. This differs from an ordinary linked worktree sharing common config.

Explicit empty included hooksPath: both wrappers keep user hook intact in this environment because real Lefthook errors with exit status 128. Owner adds a warning; both wrappers still return 0. Do not generalize this to other Git/Lefthook versions.
promotion_recommendation: Keep production ownership with aortegamel. Supply original 10/10 result plus this supplemental negative case; request the presence-based guard improvement and native Windows/macOS checks before promoting as a complete preservation fix. No new upstream PR. Owner coordination and evidence publication remain separately blocked/paused.
outside_safety_behavior: Owner retains .git presence skip and normal real hook installation, as original matrix verified.
Owner also adds an explicit warning on Lefthook failure; current main only inherits Lefthook output. This is an existing owner diagnostic change, not newly authored here.

Original genuine dependency control is npm ci missing-lock rejection (before prepare). Original product-build control is real Node SyntaxError. Neither is a full scripts/build/node-deps.mjs or Hermes updater build execution.
No CI-specific skip is added by this owner implementation. It installs normal repository hooks even with CI=1 if no custom hooksPath is set. That remains helix4u #135292's distinct scope.
No claim for inherited system config, command-scope GIT_CONFIG overrides, includeIf/onbranch conditions, query hangs/failures, native Windows/macOS, or other Lefthook versions.
assertion_summary: Eight real scenario/implementation executions; all eight match recorded expected outcomes. Four are preservation-negative controls (main CI, main whitespace, owner whitespace, main worktree-config); not described as green preservation tests.

import pathlib, tempfile, subprocess, os, json, hashlib
repo=pathlib.Path('/workspace/scratch/df37e4e44cce/wave-hooks')
def source(ref): return json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(repo),'show',f'{ref}:package.json']))['scripts']['prepare']
results=[]
for variant in ('included-ci','included-empty','included-space','worktree-config'):
  for name,ref in [('main','46d7718a'),('owner','88422bc186')]:
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='ayo hook supplement ') as tmp:
      root=pathlib.Path(tmp);home=root/'home';work=root/'repo';home.mkdir();work.mkdir()
      env={'PATH':'/tmp/ayo-hooks-lefthook/node_modules/.bin:'+os.environ['PATH'],'HOME':str(home),'USERPROFILE':str(home),'GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM':'1','GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL':str(home/'.gitconfig'),'npm_config_cache':str(root/'cache'),'npm_config_userconfig':str(home/'.npmrc'),'npm_config_globalconfig':str(home/'globalnpmrc'),'GIT_AUTHOR_NAME':'Fixture','GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL':'fixture@example.invalid','GIT_COMMITTER_NAME':'Fixture','GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL':'fixture@example.invalid'}
      if variant=='included-ci':env['CI']='1'
      def run(*args,cwd=None):
        p=subprocess.run(args,cwd=cwd or work,env=env,text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=30)
        return {'args':list(args),'status':p.returncode,'stdout':p.stdout,'stderr':p.stderr}
      assert run('git','init','--quiet')['status']==0
      assert run('git','commit','--quiet','--allow-empty','-m','fixture')['status']==0
      common=work
      if variant=='worktree-config':
        work=root/'linked';assert run('git','worktree','add','--quiet','--detach',str(work),cwd=common)['status']==0
        assert run('git','config','extensions.worktreeConfig','true')['status']==0
      hooks=work if variant=='included-empty' else work/' ' if variant=='included-space' else home/'custom hooks'
      hooks.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
      sentinel=hooks/'pre-commit';sentinel.write_text('#!/bin/sh\n# user custom sentinel\nexit 0\n');sentinel.chmod(0o755)
      (work/'lefthook.yml').write_text('pre-commit:\n  commands:\n    fixture:\n      run: "echo fixture"\n')
      (work/'package.json').write_text(json.dumps({'name':'fixture','version':'1.0.0','private':True,'scripts':{'prepare':source(ref)}}))
      globalfile=home/'.gitconfig';globalfile.write_text('# global\n')
      if variant=='worktree-config':
        assert run('git','config','--worktree','core.hooksPath',str(hooks))['status']==0
      else:
        inc=home/'included.gitconfig'; inc.write_text('# included\n')
        value='' if variant=='included-empty' else ' ' if variant=='included-space' else str(hooks)
        assert run('git','config','--file',str(inc),'core.hooksPath',value)['status']==0
        assert run('git','config','--global','include.path',str(inc))['status']==0
      configs=[p for p in [globalfile,home/'included.gitconfig',common/'.git/config'] if p.exists()]
      configs+=list((common/'.git/worktrees').glob('*/config.worktree')) if (common/'.git/worktrees').exists() else []
      before={str(p):p.read_bytes() for p in configs}; old=sentinel.read_bytes()
      query=run('git','config','--get','core.hooksPath');target=run('git','rev-parse','--git-path','hooks')
      result=run('npm','run','prepare')
      results.append({'variant':variant,'implementation':name,'query':query,'target':target,'prepare':result,'hook_preserved':sentinel.read_bytes()==old,'backup_created':(hooks/'pre-commit.old').exists(),'configs_preserved':all(p.read_bytes()==before[str(p)] for p in configs)})
print(json.dumps(results,indent=2))

empty_value_semantics: An explicitly empty configured value is present: git config --get exits 0 with a newline; git rev-parse --git-path hooks resolves ./; Lefthook's combined --path-format=absolute query errors 128. Thus checking key presence distinguishes this from an absent key (status 1), and skipping avoids a needless failing installer without mutating the value.
ready_to_post_owner_note: @aortegamel: your 88422bc186 prepare implementation passes the original 10-case real Git/npm/Lefthook matrix, plus CI=1 and worktree-specific hooksPath cases. A focused completeness check found one remaining included-config edge: core.hooksPath set to one space is a valid relative directory, but stdout.trim() removes it, so Lefthook replaces pre-commit and creates pre-commit.old while prepare returns 0. Suggest basing the skip on successful effective git-config lookup/key presence rather than trimmed value truthiness. Empty configured values also return status 0 (distinct from absence) and currently only escape replacement because Lefthook's absolute-path lookup fails. No competing production patch has been authored. Are you continuing the branch and willing to incorporate this small guard refinement?
